description: Two cuboids on a common edge with the second tilted across the edge, moving each end by two tolerances. Their shells cross in the overlap, where the union should have a single boundary.

analytic.occt_odd_euler: Open CASCADE retains shared boundary topology on its two solids.
analytic.occt_step_counts_differ: Open CASCADE writes the contact once per solid in STEP, with 16 vertices and 24 edges instead of 14 and 23 in memory.
